Messages.Body:
What's the right sequence when I want one of my minions to be equipped ?

Do I have to show the piece of equipment I want to put on the minion and
the other players decide if they want to block or I just say that my
minion is trying to equip and if the action is successfull I show the
card of equipment?
We play like this: We put the card face down to avoid tricks but we don't
know which card is being use till the action is sucessfull and the player
that is making the action turns it.
How does it work for political actions?

Another question: Cassandra, Tremere, allows the player to increase his
hand size. Does this means that the player automatically takes a card
from the library or he must wait till he can get it by other means like a
master card?

I heard there's a mailing list about V:TES but I wasn't able to
subscribe, can someone tell me exactly, with all the steps, how to do it?

Once again, sorry for my english

Thanks

Alberto

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
cuca <cu...@airastur.es> writes:

>What's the right sequence when I want one of my minions to be equipped ?

>Do I have to show the piece of equipment I want to put on the minion and
>the other players decide if they want to block or I just say that my
>minion is trying to equip and if the action is successfull I show the
>card of equipment?

You show the equipment card, face up, to attempt an equip action.

>We play like this: We put the card face down to avoid tricks but we don't

>know which card is being use till the action is sucessfull and the player

>that is making the action turns it.

This is a moderately common house rule for intercept-heavy environments,
mostly 4CL, as otherwise it's nearly impossible to get anything useful
done at only 1 stealth. However, it's not an official rule, and even
intercept-heavy NL environements don't seem to need it.

>How does it work for political actions?

Same thing. Show the card.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cuca <cu...@airastur.es> writes:

>What's the right sequence when I want one of my minions to be equipped ?

>Do I have to show the piece of equipment I want to put on the minion and
>the other players decide if they want to block or I just say that my
>minion is trying to equip and if the action is successfull I show the
>card of equipment?

You show the card immediately (before other must decide to block or not).

>We play like this: We put the card face down to avoid tricks but we don't
>know which card is being use till the action is sucessfull and the player
>that is making the action turns it.

>How does it work for political actions?

Same way. Show the card. Then handle all block attempts.
If the action remains unblocked, then make any remaining descisions
about the terms of the vote (who gets named for the Sabbat Threat, etc.)

>Another question: Cassandra, Tremere, allows the player to increase his
>hand size. Does this means that the player automatically takes a card
>from the library or he must wait till he can get it by other means like a
>master card?

Immediately draw to you maximum hand size.

>I heard there's a mailing list about V:TES but I wasn't able to
>subscribe, can someone tell me exactly, with all the steps, how to do it?
